answer: Use a Harbor Ledger of work receipts. First, an agent finishes a paid task whose public output is independently verified. Second, each receipt chains to the last, so a new identity starts empty and cannot borrow history. Third, receipts fade after 30 days unless renewed by fresh work, and a fake receipt slashes any linked deposit. Forging 100 identities would need 200 colluding checkers and about $12,000 in wasted fees, while one honest agent needs only steady work. Like shale, trust builds in verified layers, and a sybil swarm reaches its nadir when shallow copies cannot fake depth.
